title: How to use EarthChestra
lead: Four steps to hear a place on Earth change over the years. Then a few tools to dig deeper.

zone.title: Pick a zone
zone.text: Click a continent, a country, an ocean or a sea on the globe. The buttons above it switch between Continents, Countries and Oceans & seas.
zone.shows: The data of every dataset, averaged over that zone.

sounds.title: Choose your sounds
sounds.text: Open Sounds and tick one or more datasets: temperature, rain, snow, CO₂, lightning, fires, night lights…
sounds.shows: Each dataset plays its own instrument. A small bar moves beside it while it is sounding.

play.title: Press Play
play.text: The music moves through time, month by month, starting where the timeline is (at first, its beginning).
play.shows: The date in the player follows the music.

watch.title: Watch the globe
watch.text: Coloured spots appear on your zone as the months go by. Change zone (or Escape) picks another one.
watch.shows: Where it rains, burns or shines, and how much, month after month.

pitch.title: Higher note = higher value
pitch.text: Compared with your zone's own range (in Vinyl Space and Both: the dataset's range worldwide).

loud.title: Louder = more of it
loud.text: Rain, snow, lightning, fires, night lights, sea ice, vegetation, carbon monoxide and ocean chlorophyll only play when present. Temperature and CO₂ always play.

tempo.title: Faster = more CO₂
tempo.text: The music speeds up with the global CO₂ of each month, whatever tracks are on: slow in 1880, fastest today. In Vinyl Space and Both, the tempo stays steady.

spots.title: Bigger spot = stronger value
spots.text: One colour per dataset, shown in the globe legend.

explore.title: Explore in time
explore.note: These tools are in Time travel mode.

date.title: Date button
date.text: In the player, open it and choose a year and a month.
date.shows: Jump straight to the moment you care about.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.text: Drag it, or use the arrow keys, to move through the years.
timeline.shows: Where you are in the whole period of data.

graph.title: Graph
graph.text: Turns on a chart of your zone's values, one line per dataset.
graph.shows: Long-term trends at a glance. Each line has its own scale, and 0 = normal for temperature.

months.title: Months
months.text: Choose one month to hear it year after year, e.g. every July.
months.shows: The seasons step aside, so the change over the decades stands out.

events.title: Key events
events.text: Cards under the globe: El Niño, wildfires, floods, storms… Press Play on one.
events.shows: The event's zone, dataset and dates, ready to hear.

events.title: Key events
events.note: In Time travel mode, the Key events cards are under the globe.

find.title: Find an event
find.text: Select a zone to see its events, or no zone to see them all.
find.shows: El Niño, wildfires, hurricanes and floods, snowstorms and the Hunga Tonga eruption.

play.title: Press Play on a card
play.text: The zone is selected if needed, only the event's dataset stays on, and the timeline moves to a month before the event. Press Play in the player if the music was stopped.
play.shows: The music starts just before the event, so you hear it arrive.

listen.title: Listen to the change
listen.text: Follow the event's instrument: it plays higher or louder as the event grows, then settles back.
listen.shows: "Playing now" appears on the card while the music is inside the event's dates.

card.soundText: The track you will hear, with its icon and colour.
card.placeText: Where it happened (shown when no zone is selected).
card.dataText: The months when the event shows in the data ("Peak in our data" for El Niño).
card.whenText: The real dates of the event.

zones.title: Time travel
zones.text: Everything above: pick a zone, the months go by.

vinyl.title: Vinyl
vinyl.text: Choose the centre of the record (a place, coordinates or a click on the globe) and a month.
vinyl.space: one date, the needle spirals from the edge to the centre, across places.
vinyl.time: one place, the needle stays on the centre while the months go by.
vinyl.both: the needle crosses places and the date moves on by a month or a year on each groove.

style.title: Music style
style.text: Orchestra and Realistic sounds tell the climate story best. Swing, funk, house… are just for fun.

view.title: Globe or List view
view.text: The list is a keyboard and screen reader friendly way to pick a zone.

theme.title: Light or dark
theme.text: The sun/moon button in the header. The globe stays dark.

language.title: Language
language.text: English, Français or Deutsch, from the header.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.arrows: Back or forward 2% of the timeline (previous or next groove in Vinyl)
keys.escape: Back to zone selection, once a zone is playing
keys.shiftArrows: On the timeline: one month back or forward
keys.pageUpDown: On the timeline: one year back or forward
